messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Source → Hindi)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Hindi) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | **Tant'** | adverb *so* (intensifier) | इतनी | “so, to such a degree” | OK | | **è** (1st) | copular verb *is* | है | “is” | OK | | **amara** | adjective *bitter* | कड़वी | “bitter” | OK | | **che** | conjunction *that* (resultative) | कि | “that” | OK | | **poco** | adverb *little* (degree) | थोड़ा | “little, slightly” | OK | | **è** (2nd) | copular verb *is* | है | “is” | OK | | **più** | comparative *more* | अधिक | “more” | OK | | **morte** | noun *death* | मृत्यु | “death” | OK | | **ma** | coordinating conjunction *but* | परन्तु | “but” | OK | | **per** | preposition *in order to* (purpose) | के लिये | “for, in order to” | OK | | **trattar** | infinitive *to treat / discuss* | चर्चा करने | “to discuss” | OK | | **del** | contraction *of the* | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (article not required in Hindi) | | **ben** | noun *good* | अच्छा | “good” | OK | | **ch'** (1st) | relative pronoun *that* (introducing clause) | जहाँ | “where / that” | OK | | **i'** (1st) | pronoun *I* | मैं | “I” | OK | | **vi** | adverb *there* (locative) | वहाँ | “there” | OK | | **trovai** | verb *found* (past) | पाया | “found” | OK | | **dirò** | future verb *I will tell* | बताऊँगा | “will tell” | OK | | **de** | preposition *of* | के | “of” | OK | | **l'altre** | adjective *other* (with article) | अन्य | “other” | OK (article omitted naturally) | | **cose** | noun *things* (plural) | चीज़ों | “things” | OK | | **ch'** (2nd) | relative pronoun *that* | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (implicit in Hindi clause) | | **i'** (2nd) | pronoun *I* | मैं | “I” | OK | | **v'** | clitic pronoun *there* | वहाँ | “there” | OK | | **ho** | auxiliary *have* (perfect) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (perfect expressed by participle) | | **scorte** | past participle *seen* | देखी गई | “seen” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `del`, `ch'` (second occurrence), `ho` – Hindi does not need these grammatical particles/articles; their meaning is conveyed without them. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected. (The adjective *कड़वी* agrees with the implied feminine noun “बिटterness”; acceptable in Hindi.)

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 7: - Original: यह इतनी कड़वी है कि मृत्यु उससे थोड़ा अधिक कड़वी है; - Issue: none - Corrected: यह इतनी कड़वी है कि मृत्यु उससे थोड़ा अधिक कड़वी है;

- Line 9: - Original: मैं वहाँ देखी गई अन्य चीज़ों के बारे में बताऊँगा। - Issue: none - Corrected: मैं वहाँ देखी गई अन्य चीज़ों के बारे में बताऊँगा।
``` यह इतनी कड़वी है कि मृत्यु उससे थोड़ा अधिक कड़वी है; परन्तु मैं जहाँ अच्छा पाया उसके बारे में चर्चा करने के लिये, मैं वहाँ देखी गई अन्य चीज़ों के बारे में बताऊँगा। ```
